request.style: English, South African isicathamiya, a cappella male choir in close warm harmony, deep bass voices, a high falsetto lead calling and the choir answering, soft tiptoe stepping and tongue clicks, no instruments, gentle swaying swing, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the fourth watch of the night
He came walking on the sea
The disciples cried in fear
It's a ghost, what can it be

[Chorus]
Take heart, it is I
Do not be afraid
Take heart, it is I
Do not be afraid

[Verse]
Peter said, Lord, if it's you
Tell me, come to you on the water
He stepped out and walked to Jesus
But he saw the wind and sank

[Chorus]
Take heart, it is I
Do not be afraid
Take heart, it is I
Do not be afraid

[Verse]
Jesus reached out his hand
You of little faith, why did you doubt
And the wind died down
Truly you are the Son of God

[Chorus]
Take heart, it is I
Do not be afraid
